project_type: Static HTML product page with embedded JavaScript premium calculator
test_command: Validate HTML structure with grep checks on the output file
verification_instructions: Open index.html in browser, verify all tabs work, calculator produces correct results for various age/gender/benefit combinations

environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. Cannot read xlsx files programmatically. Premium data must be copied from Indexsample.html which already has it embedded as JavaScript objects.
